alerts.title: Overdue serum creatinine monitoring on TDF
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR every 12 months for patients on TDF. The patient's last creatinine was 478 days before this visit, exceeding the 12-month interval. No creatinine was ordered today. TDF can cause nephrotoxicity including chronic kidney disease and Fanconi syndrome. The prior creatinine of 88 umol/L was normal, arguing against current injury, but 16 months have elapsed without reassessment.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and eGFR now and ensure annual monitoring is scheduled for TDF renal safety.

alerts.title: Viral load 40 copies/mL near threshold
alerts.message: Guidelines define viral suppression as plasma VL ≤200 copies/mL. This patient's VL of 40 copies/mL is suppressed. However, low-level viremia above 50 copies/mL can precede treatment failure on DTG-based regimens. The clinician's plan documents no issues and no repeat VL. A repeat VL at the next routine visit would help confirm ongoing suppression and detect any upward trend early.

evidence.recommended_action: Repeat viral load at next scheduled visit to confirm sustained suppression and monitor for upward trend.
